metadata.title: Tesla Is Raising Cybertruck Prices Even as Sales Drop 32%<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Is Raising Cybertruck Prices Even as Sales Drop 32%
Tesla recently raised prices for two trims of its avant-garde Cybertruck. The move is likely about costs, not demand.
